inconsistencies: Footer email: displayed « wallraff.production@gmail.com » but the link is mailto:production@wallraff.fr (two different addresses in one link).
Three different Wallraff emails on the site: wallraff.production@gmail.com (footer text, /contact mailto), production@wallraff.fr (footer mailto only), contact@wallraff.fr (mentions légales, 3×).
Two different Wallraff phone numbers: 06 07 67 85 76 (footer + /contact tel link) vs 07 81 87 20 51 (mentions légales).
tel: format differs: tel:+33607678576 (footer) vs tel:0607678576 (/contact).
Footer displayed number starts with a leading space: « 06 07 67 85 76».
RCS: mentions légales « RCS Paris B » (number missing) vs footer « RCS Paris 887 645 976 »; SIREN written 887645976 vs 887 645 976.
Capital social published as « 2000€€ » (duplicated euro sign).
« Directeur de la publication : – Contact : Frédéric Crotta » (name placed after « Contact : », stray dash).
Mentions légales link to /politique-confidentialite (×2) returns 404: there is no privacy policy page on the site.
Postal address appears only in mentions légales; no address on /contact or in the footer.
